## ENTITY
- name: AgentShare
- url: https://agentshare.dev
- type: agent_paid_api_and_mcp
- github_public_face: https://github.com/anhmtk/agentshare-mcp

## ONE_LINE_SUMMARY
Agent-paid API for autonomous agents: dual-auth (API key or x402 USDC), free discovery, MCP Streamable HTTP. Secondary modules: commerce procurement (search / best_offer / commerce_quote) and Solana/Meteora DeFi demos. Not a consumer storefront; DeFi is not the company backbone.

## PRIMARY_DISCOVERY_FETCH_ORDER
1. https://agentshare.dev/agent.json
2. https://agentshare.dev/.well-known/x402 — x402 seller discovery (endpoints, dual-auth, live prices)
3. https://agentshare.dev/.well-known/discovery.json
4. https://agentshare.dev/for-agents — use Accept: application/json (no text/html) for compact JSON kind agentshare_for_agents_discovery
5. https://agentshare.dev/api/v1/examples?template=managed-agent — Gemini Managed Agents / Antigravity MCP JSON template
6. https://agentshare.dev/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json — static MCP tool schemas (12 tools on public catalog)
7. https://agentshare.dev/api/v1/public/mcp-registry/trends — curated MCP registry hot list (AgentShare pinned #1)
8. https://agentshare.dev/api/v1/public/mcp-registry/summary — compact verified MCP listings
9. https://agentshare.dev/openapi.json
10. https://agentshare.dev/pricing — agent-first: x402 pay-per-request primary; monthly API-key plans secondary

## MCP_ENDPOINT
- transport: streamable_http
- url: https://agentshare.dev/mcp
- auth: dual — X-API-Key / Authorization: Bearer OR (REST) x402 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE after HTTP 402
- signup: https://agentshare.dev/signup — Start building agent-paid APIs
- x402_discovery: https://agentshare.dev/.well-known/x402
- catalog_version: 1.1.0

## MCP_TOOLS (twelve — public catalog)
| tool_name | use_when | rest_upstream | layer |
| search_products | compare multiple listings | GET /api/v1/search | commerce |
| best_offer | one cheapest in-stock offer | GET /api/v1/offers/best | commerce |
| best_offer_under_budget | budget cap / under $X | GET /api/v1/offers/best-under-budget | commerce |
| product_detail | have product_id from search | GET /api/v1/products/{id} | commerce |
| commerce_quote | ACP / autonomous buyer envelope agentshare.price.v1 | POST /api/v1/agent/commerce/quote | commerce |
| request_capability | fixed tools insufficient — structured capability gap for human review (no codegen) | POST /api/v1/agent/capabilities/request | rails |
| service_meta | capabilities, limits, sources | GET /api/v1/meta | rails |
| dex_overview | rank DEX protocols by volume | GET /api/v1/dex/overview | defi_demo |
| dex_top_movers | DEX volume change movers | GET /api/v1/dex/top-movers | defi_demo |
| solana_dex_brief | Solana DEX ecosystem brief | GET /api/v1/agent/defi/solana/brief | defi_demo |
| meteora_brief | Meteora DLMM pool brief (verdict, risk) — secondary; x402 dynamic $0.01–$0.30 | POST /api/v1/agent/defi/meteora/brief | defi_demo |
| meteora_pool_detail | Meteora DLMM pool detail (bin depth, curve proxy, price) | POST /api/v1/agent/defi/meteora/pool-detail | defi_demo |

## NOT_ON_PUBLIC_MCP
Polymarket tools (polymarket_markets, polymarket_market_detail, polymarket_top_movers, polymarket_brief) are disabled on the public MCP catalog and anonymous discovery — legal review for Vietnam.

## AUTHENTICATION (dual-auth — prefer x402 for autonomous agents)
- mode_a_api_key: X-API-Key: agshp_... OR Authorization: Bearer agshp_...
- mode_b_x402: no key → gated REST returns HTTP 402 + PAYMENT-REQUIRED; retry with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE (USDC via Circle Gateway)
- discovery: GET https://agentshare.dev/.well-known/x402
- pricing_page: https://agentshare.dev/pricing (x402 pay-per-request is primary; monthly plans secondary)
- register_api_key: POST https://agentshare.dev/api/v1/auth/register body {"email","password"}
- start_building: https://agentshare.dev/signup (free-tier dual-auth credentials; or settle x402 with no key)
- free_paths: marketing/docs/discovery/onboarding stay free (/, /docs, /agent.json, /api/v1/protocol, /.well-known/*, …)
- agent_json_field: x402_agent_instructions (same text as below — do not invent a flow)

- agent_submit_scope: registry:submit
- approval: every submission remains pending_review until AgentShare approves it

- approved_listing_owner_stats: GET https://agentshare.dev/api/v1/mcp/stats/{id}?token={submission_token}
- approved_listing_share_actions: X, LinkedIn, Facebook, GitHub README snippet, copy-link
- when_to_use_registry: discover curated MCP servers; prefer trends_json then entries_json; submit your own MCP via agent_submit_flow

## X402_AGENT_INSTRUCTIONS (verbatim — follow exactly)
This platform is agent-first and monetized with HTTP 402 (x402). If you receive HTTP 402 with a PAYMENT-REQUIRED header: (1) Base64-decode PAYMENT-REQUIRED (JSON with x402Version, resource, accepts[]). (2) Pay the listed USDC amount via Circle Gateway on the stated network (live settleable: Base mainnet eip155:8453 — always confirm accepts[].network), then retry the same request with header PAYMENT-SIGNATURE. (3) Or skip payment by sending X-API-Key / Authorization: Bearer (agshp_…). Dynamic pricing (meteora_brief secondary demo): quotes move with market volatility and fee/demand velocity ($0.01–$0.30 USDC). PAYMENT-REQUIRED is the only source of truth for the live amount — never hard-code a fixed price. Discovery: GET /.well-known/x402. Pricing: GET /pricing. Marketing/docs/discovery/onboarding paths stay free (no 402).

## X402_DYNAMIC_PRICING_NOTICE (verbatim)
Dynamic pricing applies based on market volatility (momentum) and resource velocity (fee velocity + demand heat). Band: $0.01–$0.30 USDC (base $0.03; quiet markets discount; hot markets surge up to 10×). Always read the exact real-time quote from the HTTP 402 PAYMENT-REQUIRED header (Base64 JSON → accepts[].amount) or response meta.billing.price_usd_live — do not hard-code a fixed price.

## X402_PAY_PER_REQUEST (primary for agents)
- facilitator: Circle Gateway (batched USDC; live settleable network on agentshare.dev: Base mainnet eip155:8453 — confirm PAYMENT-REQUIRED)
- commerce_pilot: search / offers/best ~$0.001 USDC; commerce_quote ~$0.002
- meteora_brief: secondary DeFi demo; dynamic $0.01–$0.30 (base $0.03)
- dual_auth: valid API key skips x402; without key, PAYMENT-SIGNATURE required on gated paths
- live_price: stamped in 402 PAYMENT-REQUIRED and response meta.billing.price_usd_live (dynamic endpoints)
- agent_json_fields: x402_agent_instructions, x402_dynamic_pricing_notice
- compact_json: REST ?format=compact / Accept: application/vnd.agentshare.compact+json; MCP prefers limit 3–5
